Why these questions?

B1 or B2. B2 (32%) is limited to MSSP ACOs, in any track, and the LEAD model. Everyone else billing for complexity uses B1 (16%), including other Advanced APMs.

Conversion factor. QP status runs two years ahead: 2025 QPs get the QP rate in 2027 ($32.9548 per RVU vs $32.6286). It applies to the TIN where you were a QP.
